<sequence name="AuthenticationSequence" xmlns="http://ws.apache.org/ns/synapse">
    <filter xpath="${exists(headers.Authorization)}">
        <then>
            <variable name="authHeader" expression="${headers.Authorization}" type="STRING"/>
            <filter xpath="${startsWith(vars.authHeader, 'Bearer ')}">
                <then>
                    <variable name="token" expression="${subString(vars.authHeader, 7)}" type="STRING"/>
                    <log category="INFO">
                        <message>Authentication successful for token: ${vars.token}</message>
                    </log>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <throwError type="AUTH_ERROR" errorMessage="Invalid authorization header format"/>
                </else>
            </filter>
        </then>
        <else>
            <throwError type="AUTH_ERROR" errorMessage="Authorization header missing"/>
        </else>
    </filter>
</sequence>

        <case regex="AUTH_ERROR">
            <payloadFactory media-type="json">
                <format>{
                    "status": "error",
                    "code": "401",
                    "message": "Authentication failed",
                    "detail": "${vars.errorMessage}"
                }</format>
            </payloadFactory>
            <header name="HTTP_SC" value="401" scope="transport"/>
        </case>
        <case regex="VALIDATION_ERROR">
            <payloadFactory media-type="json">
                <format>{
                    "status": "error",
                    "code": "400",
                    "message": "Validation failed",
                    "detail": "${vars.errorMessage}"
                }</format>
            </payloadFactory>
            <header name="HTTP_SC" value="400" scope="transport"/>
        </case>
        <default>
            <payloadFactory media-type="json">
                <format>{
                    "status": "error",
                    "code": "500",
                    "message": "Internal server error",
                    "detail": "${vars.errorMessage}"
                }</format>
            </payloadFactory>
            <header name="HTTP_SC" value="500" scope="transport"/>
        </default>
    </switch>
    
    <respond/>

    <variable name="requestId" expression="${now()}" type="STRING"/>
    <variable name="endpoint" expression="${props.synapse.REST_URL_POSTFIX}" type="STRING"/>
    <variable name="method" expression="${props.synapse.REST_METHOD}" type="STRING"/>
    
    <log category="INFO">
        <message>Request ID: ${vars.requestId} | Method: ${vars.method} | Endpoint: ${vars.endpoint}</message>
    </log>
    
    <dblookup>
        <connection>
            <pool>
                <driver>com.mysql.jdbc.Driver</driver>
                <url>jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/bankdb</url>
                <user>bankuser</user>
                <password>bankpass</password>
            </pool>
        </connection>
        <statement>
            <sql>INSERT INTO api_logs (request_id, method, endpoint, timestamp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, NOW())</sql>
            <parameter expression="${vars.requestId}" type="VARCHAR"/>
            <parameter expression="${vars.method}" type="VARCHAR"/>
            <parameter expression="${vars.endpoint}" type="VARCHAR"/>
        </statement>
    </dblookup>
</sequence>

<sequence name="NotificationSequence" xmlns="http://ws.apache.org/ns/synapse">
    <variable name="customerEmail" expression="${payload.customerEmail}" type="STRING"/>
    <variable name="transactionType" expression="${payload.transactionType}" type="STRING"/>
    <variable name="amount" expression="${payload.amount}" type="STRING"/>
    
    <email.send configKey="EmailConnection">
        <from>bank@example.com</from>
        <to>${vars.customerEmail}</to>
        <subject>Transaction Notification - ${vars.transactionType}</subject>
        <content>Dear Customer,

Your ${vars.transactionType} transaction of ${vars.amount} has been processed successfully.

Transaction ID: ${payload.transactionId}
Timestamp: ${formatDateTime(now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')}

Thank you for banking with us.

Best regards,
O2 Bank</content>
        <contentType>text/plain</contentType>
    </email.send>
    
    <log category="INFO">
        <message>Notification sent to ${vars.customerEmail}</message>

<sequence name="RateLimitSequence" xmlns="http://ws.apache.org/ns/synapse">
    <variable name="clientId" expression="${headers['X-Client-ID']}" type="STRING"/>
    
    <filter xpath="${exists(vars.clientId)}">
        <then>
            <throttle id="BankAPIThrottle">
                <policy>
                    <wsp:Policy xmlns:wsp="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2004/09/policy"
                                xmlns:throttle="http://www.wso2.org/products/wso2commons/throttle">
                        <throttle:ThrottleAssertion>
                            <throttle:MaximumConcurrentAccess>10</throttle:MaximumConcurrentAccess>
                            <wsp:Policy>
                                <throttle:ID throttle:type="IP">other</throttle:ID>
                                <wsp:Policy>
                                    <throttle:Control>
                                        <wsp:Policy>
                                            <throttle:MaximumCount>100</throttle:MaximumCount>
                                            <throttle:UnitTime>60000</throttle:UnitTime>
                                        </wsp:Policy>
                                    </throttle:Control>
                                </wsp:Policy>
                            </wsp:Policy>
                        </throttle:ThrottleAssertion>
                    </wsp:Policy>
                </policy>
                <onAccept>
                    <log category="INFO">
                        <message>Request accepted for client: ${vars.clientId}</message>
                    </log>
                </onAccept>
                <onReject>
                    <payloadFactory media-type="json">
                        <format>{
                            "status": "error",
                            "message": "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later."
                        }</format>
                    </payloadFactory>
                    <respond/>
                </onReject>
            </throttle>
        </then>
        <else>
            <throwError type="VALIDATION_ERROR" errorMessage="Client ID header missing"/>
        </else>
    </filter>
</sequence>

</template>
